            factors = re.findall(r'[Mm]ultiply\s+by\s+(\d+\.?\d*)', policy_text)
            if factors:

            # Look for constant additions
            import re
            adds = re.findall(r'[Aa]dd\s+(\d+\.?\d*)', policy_text)
            if adds:
                add_value = float(adds[0])
                result = result + add_value
                adjustments += 1
        
        conn.close()
        
        if adjustments > 0:
            print(f"Applied {adjustments} adjustments from {policy_source} policy")
        
        return result
